purpose: Evaluate whether one model-loaded run over the full vendored FP&A corpus surfaces source-grounded entity identities and directed endpoint relationships before schema/type enforcement.
sourceOrdering: sources array order; all loader-produced documents from a source remain contiguous

matchingPolicy.entityAlignment: Global by key; match canonical name or acceptedNames after Unicode NFKC, case, punctuation, and whitespace normalization.
matchingPolicy.relationExistence: At this level, every critical relation requires a directed edge from a matched source entity to a matched target entity.
matchingPolicy.predicateAssessment: canonicalPredicate and acceptedPredicates are diagnostic only when matchMode is DIRECTED_ENDPOINTS. They are used to report exact, alias, ambiguous, or unmapped predicate output for later schema tightening.
matchingPolicy.criticalAssertions: Every entity and relation marked critical=true must be present.
matchingPolicy.extras: Additional source-backed entities and relations are allowed and reported.
matchingPolicy.types: Entity types, relation signatures, and properties are intentionally not scored at this level.

Subject: EMEA Q3 2026 forecast — for consolidation
From: François Vasseur <f.vasseur@northstar.eu>
To: Mei Chen <m.chen@northstar.co>
Attachment: EMEA forecast Jun-Aug 2026.xlsx

François Vasseur submits the attached EMEA forecast for corporate consolidation. The attached EMEA Q3 2026 forecast covers June, July, and August 2026. Amounts are in local currency: GBP for the United Kingdom and EUR for the Eurozone. Amounts are in thousands of local currency and are gross of VAT. Corporate consolidation uses the centrally locked 3-month forward curve rather than spot. The workbook's FX rates for reference are spot rates used only for an internal sanity check.

EMEA uses DTC, Marketplace, Retail, and Distributor. Map Marketplace to Amazon, and map Retail and Distributor to Wholesale. The product-code mapping to the corporate SKU master is EMEA_SKU_master_v8.xlsx.

The forecast assumes that the Boots written purchase order is received this week. If it slips into Q4, approximately GBP 280,000 is at risk for the quarter.

Source document: Discovery interview with J. Park, 22 April 2026.
J. Park explains that the SOP requires variances above USD 1,000 to be returned to the region. In actual operations, when a variance matches a known coding pattern and can be fixed within 10 minutes, J. Park fixes it locally; otherwise it is returned or escalated. Known patterns include SKU-code typos, channel mismatches, currency-tag variation, calendar shifts, and stale FX.

Mei Chen has a standing override: every channel mismatch must be escalated to Mei Chen regardless of amount or whether it can be corrected within 10 minutes. The override was communicated verbally in a 2025 one-on-one and is not documented in the SOP.

The SOP specifies email for regional escalation, but the operational rule is to use Slack DM. The Slack compliance archive provides the audit trail, is backed by S3, and retains records for seven years.
